text:
anya: Heads-up — found a weird billing/quota mismatch when impersonating a service account from the console. Repro steps below, happy to jump in a call if needed.
anya: Steps: 1) Console -> Test request (project: proj-frontend) 2) Toggle 'Impersonate SA' -> select sa-analytics@org 3) Send request, observe quota charged on org-root instead of proj-frontend.
anya: Attached request headers I see in the trace: `X-Auth: sa=sa-analytics; project=proj-frontend; org=org-root`
anya: Relevant log snippet from router (redacted):
```
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] request_id=req_0x123 auth_claims={"sa":"sa-analytics","project":"proj-frontend","org":"org-root"} route=platform-authz evaluate=>fallback_to_org true charge_target=org-root
```
jordan: Huh. Is the console intentionally setting org-root anywhere? The console should send an effective_project header after impersonation, right?
jordan: Could be our fallthrough: if SA has no explicit project binding we route to the SA's owner org. But you said you picked a project in the UI.
samir: I can repro locally. Console UX sends `impersonation_subject=sa-...` and `console_project=proj-frontend`. Router reads `effective_project` by priority: exchange_claim.project || console_project || sa_owner_project. Looks like exchange_claim is winning and is null, then console_project should win — will dig.
lena: Two quick asks: 1) Can we capture whether the routing decision used `console_project` or `sa_owner_project` in telemetry? 2) We need a console UX hint if the SA doesn't have a binding and we fall back to org billing.
ops-bot: dev-deploy: canary router push v3.21 scheduled at 22:00 PDT. No infra changes blocked.
samir: Found the bug — a small race in our claim synthesis: when impersonation occurs we emit `exchange_claim.project` only after we resolve SA alias mapping; console request handler forwards `console_project` as `X-Console-Project` but our auth proxy strips unknown headers unless `X-Forwarded-For` set. Net result: `console_project` is being dropped for impersonation flows.
anya: Ugh. So router sees neither and falls back to org. That explains it.
jordan: For telemetry: let's add a boolean tag `charge_via_console_project` and `charge_via_sa_owner` to quota_meter and an `ui_hint_shown` flag. That will make the billing SLO dashboards show how often users are surprised.
lena: Agreed. Also add a short console alert: if selected SA has no project binding and router would charge org, show "Requests will be billed to org-root — you can set a default project on the SA" with link to docs. Small UX tweak but reduces support load.
samir: Plan: 1) fix header forwarding in auth proxy (small PR), 2) add telemetry tags in router + quota meters (adds two fields), 3) deploy canary, validate metrics for 24h. I'll attach PRs.
anya: Perfect. Can we also add a temporary query param `?force_project=proj-frontend` so infra can verify telemetry without waiting for console UX change?
jordan: I'd prefer a header toggle instead of query param; query params get cached in logs differently. Use `X-Force-Project` for internal-only debugging.
ops-bot: reminder: please add feature flag `authz:console-impersonation-fix` so we can roll back quickly from canary if there are auth regressions.
lena: Also notify support & billing about potential incorrect charges window. Add a short note to #support with reproducible steps and PS: these are small customer-visible billing spikes until fix lands.
samir: will open PRs and update this thread with links. ETA for PR review: 3 hours.
anya: Thanks — appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
